description: Cast a Qimen Dunjia (奇门遁甲, time-based chai bu) chart for a local clock date and time. Returns the four pillars, Yin/Yang Dun and Ju number, Zhi Fu / Zhi Shi, and the nine palaces with heaven/earth stems, star, door, deity, 81-pattern name, void and horse markers.

hour.description: Local clock hour (24h) where the question is asked.

name: qimen_chart
title: Cast a Qimen Dunjia chart
